pest_context.favorable_condition: Warm temperatures (25–30 °C) and continuous maize cropping
pest_context.cultural_notes: Monitor whorl damage early; rotate with non-host legumes and avoid staggered planting.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Moderate temperatures (18–27 °C) with prolonged leaf wetness and high humidity
pest_context.cultural_notes: Use resistant hybrids, manage infected crop residue, and rotate away from Poaceae hosts.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Cool to moderate temperatures (10–25 °C) with morning dew or frequent light rain
pest_context.cultural_notes: Select regionally resistant cultivars and eliminate volunteer cereal bridges.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Warm, humid weather (20–30 °C, RH > 80%) coinciding with flowering/anthesis
pest_context.cultural_notes: Avoid planting wheat directly after maize without residue management; monitor flowering humidity.

pest_context.favorable_condition: High relative humidity (>85%), prolonged leaf wetness, and excessive nitrogen availability
pest_context.susceptible_stage: seedling, tillering, and panicle neck emergence
pest_context.cultural_notes: Use blast-resistant varieties, avoid excessive nitrogen top-dressing, and maintain balanced water depth.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Warm temperatures (25–34 °C), heavy rain, strong winds, and deep flooding
pest_context.cultural_notes: Plant resistant cultivars, use clean seed, and avoid seedling root clipping during transplanting.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Temperatures of 18–28 °C with >6 hours of continuous leaf wetness
pest_context.cultural_notes: Observe host-free periods, monitor lower canopy leaves at flowering, and use tolerant maturity groups.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Warm, humid weather (24–30 °C) with frequent rainfall and splash dispersal
pest_context.cultural_notes: Practice 2–3 year rotation with cereals, bury crop debris, and use tolerant varieties.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Late-season terminal drought and high soil temperatures (28–35 °C) during pod maturation
pest_context.cultural_notes: Minimize end-of-season drought stress where supplemental irrigation exists, avoid pod damage at harvest, and dry rapidly below 9% moisture.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Cool to moderate temperatures (17–24 °C) with high humidity and rain splash
pest_context.cultural_notes: Plant pathogen-free seed, avoid working in wet fields, and rotate away from Phaseolus for 2–3 years.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Cool, wet conditions (12–22 °C) with relative humidity >90%
pest_context.susceptible_stage: vegetative canopy closure to tuber bulking
pest_context.cultural_notes: Use certified seed tubers, eliminate cull piles, maintain hilling, and monitor humid blight weather periods.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Warm soil temperatures (>25 °C) and high soil moisture or poor drainage
pest_context.cultural_notes: Avoid rotating tomato with potato, eggplant, or chili pepper; improve field drainage and use resistant rootstocks/varieties.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Warm temperatures (24–29 °C) with alternating wet and dry periods
pest_context.cultural_notes: Rotate out of Solanaceae, stake/prune for canopy airflow, and remove infected debris.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Low soil fertility and intermittent drought in semi-arid cereal mono-cropping
pest_context.cultural_notes: Rotate or intercrop with trap crops (soybean, cowpea, groundnut, desmodium) and build soil organic matter.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Cool, wet weather (15–25 °C) with rain splash during vegetative and flowering stages
pest_context.cultural_notes: Use clean seed, resistant cultivars, and a minimum 3-year rotation between chickpea crops.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Warm temperatures (25–32 °C) with staggered host crops
pest_context.cultural_notes: Scout squares and bolls regularly, conserve natural enemies, and destroy post-harvest stalks promptly.

pest_context.favorable_condition: High whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) vector populations under warm conditions
pest_context.susceptible_stage: early vegetative sprouting to 4 months after planting
pest_context.cultural_notes: Use virus-free stem cuttings from resistant varieties and rogue symptomatic plants early.

pest_context.favorable_condition: Prolonged wet soil and humid weather (18–25 °C) during flowering
pest_context.cultural_notes: Maintain at least 3–4 years between susceptible broadleaf hosts (sunflower, soybean, rapeseed, dry bean) using cereal rotations.
